step: LONG-TAIL BATCH D, FIX 1 - King's Shield's contact punish goes through `applyStatDrop`, the ONE stat-drop implementation, instead of writing the vector straight into `boosts`. data/moves.ts:9946-9948 is `this.boost({atk:-1}, source, target, getActiveMove("King's Shield"))`, and three facts hang off that call which the raw write had none of: Contrary inverts the sign, Defiant/Competitive retaliate per stat lowered by a non-ally, and the Clear Body class refuses it and writes `|-fail|<attacker>|unboost|[from] ability: ...`.
what_changed: engine/medicham2-browser.js (the punishesContact `boosts` branch, one knob, three counters)
no_tag_regeneration: data/tags.json is UNTOUCHED. `punishesContact {onContact:true, boosts:{atk:-1}}` and `invertsBoosts {inverts:true}` were already derived and already correct; the defect was one consumer bypassing the shared reader.

which_scoreboard: BOARD-MATERIAL. `boosts.atk` is a compared leaf and the probe shows the board comparator itself calling the three arms DIFF. Said before the run: this is the first fix in three batches that should move the bar, and it should move PROTOCOL by the same games.

cause_rows_that_must_go_to_zero: unrelated event mismatch :: |-boost|p2a|atk|1 <> |-unboost|p2a|atk|1  (n=1, BOARD-MATERIAL, same turn)
unrelated event mismatch :: |-boost|p2b|atk|1 <> |-unboost|p2b|atk|1  (n=1, BOARD-MATERIAL, same turn)
prediction.reasoning: Both rows were bucketed out of the FULL by-cause list in `end_state[0].summary.by_cause` (110 causes, 114 games, reconciles), not out of `state.first_board_divergences`, which is capped at 40 and is not the population. Both are `board_parted_same_turn`, so the board first parts AT this cause rather than five turns downstream, and both are the same fixture read off the dump: a Staraptor-Mega Brave Bird into an Aegislash King's Shield. Staraptor-Mega's only ability is Contrary, DERIVED off its own species row (`D.species.get('staraptormega').abilities` -> {"0":"Contrary"}), which is why the authority writes `-boost atk 1` where this engine wrote `-unboost atk 1`. 50 - 2 = 48 and 114 - 2 = 112.
prediction.why_it_might_miss_HIGH: A game that stops diverging here can simply diverge later - that is what happened to 2 of the 17 Struggle rows in batch C. If either game re-parts, board-material lands at 49 or 50 with a NEW cause row naming something else, and the fix is still correct.
prediction.why_it_might_miss_LOW: Defiant is 17,379 sheets and Competitive 3,431, against 418 King's Shield uses. A Defiant or Clear Body body touching a King's Shield in a game that was ALREADY diverging for another reason would have been masked, and unmasking it could close a THIRD game. Anything below 48 must be re-joined by cause before it is claimed - a game closing that this fix cannot explain is an attribution failure, not a bonus.

counters.MEDSEEN.shieldPunishThroughStatDrop: > 0 over the pool, and it must equal the number of contact clicks a King's Shield refused. A zero means the wire is dead and any delta belongs to something else.
